summary: Initial testing of BisaFit fitness app. Backend API tests all pass (9/9). Frontend tests show intermittent Cloudflare rate limiting/bot protection causing blank pages in automated tests. When pages load, all features work correctly - landing page, auth, terms, pricing sections all render properly.

issues.description: Privacy Policy page shows blank content - the useLegalDocument hook fetches from Supabase but returns null/empty. The page renders but has no content visible.
Contact page triggers Cloudflare security verification challenge, blocking automated access. This may affect real users with certain browser configurations.

Frontend has Vite errors for missing Capacitor plugins (@capacitor-community/secure-storage-plugin, @capacitor-community/app-tracking-transparency). These are mobile-only plugins and don't affect web functionality but should be conditionally imported.
No data-testid attributes found in frontend components. Adding these would improve test reliability and maintainability.

action_items: Investigate why Privacy Policy page content is not loading from Supabase legal_documents table
Add data-testid attributes to key interactive elements for better test coverage
Consider adding conditional imports for Capacitor plugins to avoid Vite errors in web environment

test_results.frontend: Intermittent due to Cloudflare - 1/7 passed when rate limited, all pass when not limited

seed_data_creation: None - tests use existing data or create temporary test data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API is fully functional. Frontend tests are affected by Cloudflare bot protection causing intermittent blank pages. The app itself works correctly - landing page shows hero, features, pricing, FAQ, footer with Bisa Group LLC. Auth page shows sign in/sign up forms. Terms page loads correctly. Privacy page has content loading issue from Supabase. Protected routes (home, plan, nutrition, settings, billing) require authentication and were not tested due to no test credentials being available.
rca_of_issue: Frontend test failures are due to Cloudflare rate limiting/bot protection, not app bugs. The first test in each run typically passes, subsequent tests get blank pages. This is an infrastructure issue, not a code issue.
